view: Frontal (PA) erect chest radiograph; 'L' side marker present at image upper right, confirming conventional orientation (patient's right on image left)
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (approximately 9-10 posterior ribs visible), no significant rotation (clavicular heads roughly equidistant from spinous processes), penetration adequate with vertebral bodies visible through the cardiac silhouette. Edge-enhanced processing gives the bronchovascular markings a somewhat coarse appearance. Whole thorax included; costophrenic angles and both apices within the field. A black rectangular blocker artifact at the far left edge of the image (outside the patient) and a thin bright collimation line along the right edge are technical only.

devices.type: External radiographic side marker ('L' letter with adjacent round radiopaque disc)
devices.location: Image upper right corner, projected over the patient's left shoulder / lateral to the left clavicle (outside the lung field)

devices.type: Black rectangular digital blocker / collimation artifact (not on the patient)
devices.location: Far left edge of the image, upper third, lateral to the patient's right shoulder

description_zh: 正面（PA）站立胸部X光，吸氣量足夠、無明顯旋轉，影像品質尚可；影像右上角可見 L 側別標記及圓形金屬標記，影像左緣有黑色遮擋偽影，均為體外物，未見胸管、引流管、中心靜脈導管、心律調節器或其他植入裝置。雙側肺野上、中、下各區均清晰透亮，支氣管血管紋理因影像後處理而略顯粗糙，但仍在正常範圍，未見實質浸潤、結節、腫塊、肺門腫大或氣胸；雙側肋膈角銳利，橫膈輪廓平滑，右側橫膈略高於左側屬正常。心臟大小正常（心胸比 < 0.5），縱膈不寬，氣管居中，主動脈弓正常；肋骨、鎖骨、脊椎及軟組織未見異常。結論：未見明顯異常之胸部X光。
